input: Find the equation of a plane containing the line of intersection of the planes 2x - y - 4 = 0 and y + 2z - 4 = 0 and passing through the point (2,1,0).
thinking: General plane through intersection: (2x - y -4) + λ(y + 2z -4) = 0. Plug point (2,1,0): 2(2)-1-4 + λ(1 + 0 -4) = 0 => 4-1-4 + λ(-3) = 0 => -1 -3λ =0 => λ = -1/3. Substitute: 2x - y -4 + (-1/3)(y + 2z -4)=0. Multiply by 3: 6x -3y -12 - (y + 2z -4) =0 => 6x -4y -2z -8 =0 => divide by 2: 3x -2y - z -4 =0. Rearranged: 3x -2y - z =4.
